Method of Attack: Information-stealing and RAT malware using Cloudflare Tunnel to bypass firewall restrictions
Impacted Systems: Users who downloaded the packages from PyPI
Attack Vector: Malicious PyPI packages with base64-encoded PowerShell scripts that download and install additional malware
Indicators of Compromise: Persistence mechanisms, keystroke logger, data exfiltration of cryptocurrency wallets, browser cookies and passwords, Telegram data, Discord tokens, use of transfer[.]sh and ping to onion site
